content:
mira: Quick heads-up — 2pm sync to run through the final GA ticklist. I want firm yes/no on SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing before EOD.
joel: copying the list we'll go through. have we locked p95 latency targets?
sam: not fully. SRE proposal: p95 < 250ms for 512 tokens on hosted, 99.95% monthly uptime. can we take that to product?
mira: 99.95% is acceptable as a baseline. we need explicit credit policy for breaches (what we refund). any legal constraints?
ravi: finance prefers a tiered credit: 10% credits for 99.9-99.95, 25% below 99.9. run the numbers vs CAC and reserves.
anya: docs checklist: quickstart, API reference, migration guide for existing beta users, and a one-pager for enterprise on SLA + data handling. ETA: EOD tomorrow if we get final text.
joel: engineering checklist: canary rollout plan (10% -> 50% -> 100%), fallback model variant mapping, and an automatic rollback window of 15m if errors spike.
sam: monitoring/action: need these dashboards and alerts before greenlight:
sam: ```
- Dashboard: per-model latency p50/p95/p99, error-rate, tokens/sec
- Alert: error_rate > 0.5% sustained over 5m -> P1
- Alert: p95 > 2x baseline over 10m -> P1
- Synthetic: hourly health-check hitting /v1/generate with 512-token payload
```
mira: can you paste the synthetic curl snippet? we should include it in runbook.
sam: sure — ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-open-1","input":"health check x512"}'```
joel: engineering will wire that synthetic into the smoke runner and public canary.
anya: support playbooks: triage steps for Error 503 and rate-limit anomalies, list of contacts (SRE, infra, on-call eng), and remediation steps with commands. I'll draft and link in the runbook.
mira: ownership notes: SLA doc — mira/ravi; pricing runbook and quota mapping — ravi/joel; docs — anya; monitoring + alerts + runbook — sam/joel. please confirm.
ravi: confirmed for pricing and billing smoke tests. I'll schedule a billing test at 11am tomorrow (sandbox charge + invoice reconciliation).
joel: confirmed for rollout automation and fallback rules.
sam: confirmed for dashboards and synthetic monitors; will add alert thresholds to paging config.
anya: confirmed for docs; need final SLA wording for the enterprise one-pager (legal-friendly).
devex-bot: Reminder: postmortem and runbook templates are in https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/runbooks — new GA checklist items should link back.
mira: ok last bucket — pricing readiness: tier definitions, quotas, and free tier limits. we need explicit rate limits and quota enforcement plan for GA to avoid noisy tenants.
ravi: proposal: free tier = 100k tokens/month, burst rate 10rps; paid starter = 1M tokens/month, custom quotas for enterprise. will circulate a spreadsheet.
joel: tech note: quota enforcement will be token-based with soft-override for enterprise during onboarding. implement per-token counters in cache for low latency.
mira: final decision call: if all owners confirm by 5pm, we run the canary tomorrow and aim for GA next week. objections?
sam: no objections from SRE, but we'll need a short burn-in at 10% for 4 hours.
anya: docs will be ready for review by 4:30pm.
ravi: finance sign-off pending quick risk calc — will update by 3:30pm.
joel: engineering OK with the timeline assuming no last-minute infra changes.
mira: perfect. I'll send the 2pm invite and the checklist. thanks all :rocket:
